sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Pighead Snapshot Slide Adventure are simple yet challenging. The game presents you with a grid of tiles, each containing a piece of a larger picture. Your goal is to slide the tiles to reassemble the picture by creating a valid connection between them. The tiles can be moved horizontally or vertically, but not diagonally. You can only move one tile at a time, and you must make sure that the tile you move is adjacent to the tile you want to move. As you progress through the game, the puzzles become increasingly difficult, and you'll need to use your problem-solving skills to figure out how to reassemble the picture.

One of the key features of Pighead Snapshot Slide Adventure is its ability to adapt to your playing style.
